name: Crispy Cheese Smashed Sweet Potato Pancakes with Chili Egg
desc: Smashed sweet potatoes fried into a crisp cheddar base, topped with a chili-crisp fried egg.

source.title: Crispy Cheese Smashed Sweet Potato Pancakes + Chili Egg
source.evidence: Saved Instagram reel; caption and on-screen text captured in the owner's saved-recipes export

ingredients.raw: 1 to 1 1/2 cups shredded sharp cheddar (4 to 6 small handfuls)
Salt and black pepper, to taste
1 to 2 tbsp crispy chili oil (such as Lao Gan Ma)
1/4 cup crème fraîche or plain Greek yogurt
ingredients.item: crème fraîche or plain Greek yogurt

ingredients.raw: 1 tbsp fresh chives or green onion, sliced

steps: Prick the sweet potatoes all over with a fork. Microwave on high 15 to 20 minutes, until a knife slides in easily.
One at a time, put a potato between two sheets of parchment and smash it about 1/2 inch thick with a burger press, spatula or the bottom of a pan. Season with salt and pepper.
Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat with no oil. Add the cheese in small rounds about the size of a smashed potato and set a potato on each.
Cook until the cheese is golden and crisp, 3 to 4 minutes, then flip and cook until the other side is golden and crisp. Work in batches.
Wipe the pan clean. Heat the chili oil over medium heat, crack in the eggs and fry until the whites are set at the edges. Cover with a lid for the last 15 to 20 seconds to set the whites on top.
Stack the sweet potato pancakes and top with the eggs, crème fraîche, pickled onions, extra chili crisp and chives.
tips: The cheese goes into the dry pan first, with no oil, so it melts into a crisp frico base.
Plant-based cheese works too. Pesto can stand in for the chili oil; add a little extra oil to fry the eggs.
